name: bws_get_connection
description: Identify the paired BWS browser workspace and active AI plugin.

name: bws_get_capabilities
description: Read supported BWS operations, limits, units, axes, and current engine capabilities before editing.

name: bws_get_scene
description: Read the current scene and its editable objects.

name: bws_get_selection
description: Read the current BWS selection.

name: bws_get_audit
description: Read the latest workspace audit and operation history.

name: bws_model_qa_sheet
description: Return an inline QA-sheet PNG with all six full-model camera views and the loaded project reference image.

name: bws_create_objects
description: Create explicitly described objects in the paired BWS scene.

name: bws_create_mesh_from_reference_image
description: Create an editable BWS mesh from a base64 reference image and explicit generation parameters.

name: bws_combine_objects_into_shell
description: Fuse exact scene object IDs into one editable outer shell, replacing source parts.

name: bws_update_objects
description: Update exact objects in the paired BWS scene.

name: bws_delete_objects
description: Delete exact objects from the paired BWS scene.

name: bws_set_selection
description: Set the selected objects in the paired BWS scene.

name: bws_sculpt_parts
description: List editable mesh parts with stable IDs, names, checked state, and triangle counts.

name: bws_sculpt_preview_image
description: Return the dedicated Triangle Sculpt preview with model patch, cursor, and selection.

name: bws_sculpt_qa_sheet
description: Return the Triangle Sculpt QA composite with the loaded reference image.

name: bws_sculpt_viewport_image
description: Return only the largest visible BWS workspace canvas.

name: bws_sculpt_prepare
description: Prepare exact parts as the active sculpt target with optional subdivision.

name: bws_sculpt_look_at_selected
description: Focus the sculpt preview and cursor on a selected part.

name: bws_sculpt_state
description: Read the active sculpt target, triangle selection, cursor, radius, mode, and bounds.

name: bws_sculpt_set_tool
description: Set the virtual sculpt cursor center, radius, and selection mode.

name: bws_sculpt_select_local
description: Select triangles, vertices, edges, or faces around the virtual cursor.

name: bws_sculpt_select_grid
description: Select triangle centroids in a projected front, side, or top grid rectangle.

name: bws_sculpt_select_brush
description: Select nearby projected triangle centroids with a bounded brush.

name: bws_sculpt_subdivide_local
description: Subdivide only the selected local sculpt patch within the triangle safety ceiling.

name: bws_sculpt_symmetrize_patch
description: Apply uniform subdivision, centerline treatment, or mirrored patch topology.

name: bws_sculpt_push_pull
description: Deform the current sculpt selection along normals or a world axis with falloff controls.

name: bws_sculpt_relax
description: Relax or smooth the selected sculpt patch with boundary preservation controls.

name: bws_sculpt_clear_selection
description: Clear the active sculpt selection without changing mesh geometry.

name: bws_undo
description: Undo the most recent BWS edit.
